visual.name: dbxStackedColumn
visual.description: One chart visual with fifteen chart types (stacked / 100% / clustered column, bar, stacked bar, 100% stacked bar, line, area, stacked area, 100% stacked area, scatter, two combos, ribbon, donut) plus a built-in dimension selector, Monthly/Quarterly/Annual switch and chart/table toggle. Chart type is a setting and the field wells and table view are the same for every type. Removes the need for bookmarks, field-parameter slicers and layered shapes.
